reviews.title: LOVE! Aesthetic, Easy, Helpful!
reviews.text:
I genuinely love this app! One of my favorite features is the mood tracking. You can track your moods and even create your own custom moods with matching faces that blend seamlessly with the aesthetic of the app.

I currently have **four different widgets** from this one app on my Home Screen because I love tracking things *to a point* 😂, and the widget options are honestly amazing. Everything is customizable, useful, and still looks beautiful on my phone.

It has also made it so much easier for me to create habits and check them off throughout the day, while also keeping track of my events and the tasks I need to complete.

I get overwhelmed **sooo easily** and tend to get decision paralysis when I feel like I have too much to do or too many things to think about. This app has really helped me lay everything out in a way that feels simple and manageable. Being able to see everything organized in one place helps me feel less overwhelmed, more productive, and genuinely accomplished throughout the day.

If you're someone who loves staying organized but also wants something aesthetic, customizable, and actually enjoyable to use, I definitely recommend this app!

reviews.title: Very Helpful Tool for AuDHD
reviews.text:
I came across this app while looking for a digital weekly planner. The aesthetic caught my eye first but I also love the different capabilities of this app. Sometimes I can get overwhelmed with apps that have too many features but this one has a really great balance for my AuDHD brain. 

I was late diagnosed at age 36 a little less than a year ago and since then, I have been gradually building up my toolbox and finding what works. The habit tracker combined with diary entry helps me keep track of which days I take my meds and complete my morning walks (without the pressure of it being demanding or being concerned with breaking a streak) while being able to see how my moods may or may not be affected on those days. Also this app syncs with my calendar, allowing me to see a snapshot of my FULL day in one screen. I can see tasks, daily habits, mood, and calendar events all in one place.

I was pleasantly surprised to see that when a task isn’t completed on a specific day that it doesn’t just disappear into the abyss. It rolls over into the next day. This may not be the best fit for some people, but for me it’s perfect because it saves me the energy of having to manually retype the same task for another day, OR even running the risk of forgetting that the task even existed in the first place!

I’ve been using the app for less than a week but within the first hour of using it, I could see that it would be a good tool for me to organize my day and get better at managing my time. It’s not a magic fix and I’m still battling executive function issues at times, but this app definitely helps me smooth out some of the kinks. I am thankful!
